8.29.4.1. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.path_area.FirstAreaInPath.__init__¶

FirstAreaInPath.__init__(argOrder=None)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:
  • nthArea (int) – A positive number indicating the index (starting from 1) of area in path.
  • areaUserTypes (Iterable(string) | string | none) – Types of areas that are counted. An argument of None will be interpreted as “no restriction”, i.e. all user subtypes of base type AREA_TYPE are considered.
  • argOrder (vtuple(int)?) – See GeoPredicate.
